[[Paykan F.C.|Paykan]], [[Persepolis F.C.|Persepolis]] | prevseason = [[2009–10 Persian Gulf Cup|2009–10]] | nextseason = [[2011–12 Persian Gulf Cup|2011–12]] }} The '''2010–11 Persian Gulf Cup''' (also known as '''Iran Pro League''') was the 28th season of [[Persian Gulf Pro League|Iran's Football League]] and tenth as [[Persian Gulf Pro League|Iran Pro League]] since its establishment in 2001. [[Sepahan F.C.|Sepahan]] were the [[2009–10 Persian Gulf Cup|defending champions]]. The season featured 15 teams from the [[2009–10 Persian Gulf Cup]] and three new teams promoted from the [[2009–10 Azadegan League]]: [[Shahrdari Tabriz F.C.|Shahrdari Tabriz]] and [[Naft Tehran F.C.|Naft Tehran]] both as champions and [[Sanat Naft Abadan F.C.|Sanat Naft]]. The league started on 26 July 2010 and ended on 20 May 2011. [[Sepahan F.C.|Sepahan]] won the Pro League title for the third time in their history (total third Iranian title).
